findings.description: active_skus is a list, so `scan.sku not in active_skus` is a linear scan for every scan. With C active catalog items and S scans, unknown_locations does O(C*S) work, which slows down reconciliation of large stocktakes (tens of thousands of SKUs and scans). Nothing else in reconcile() is this expensive, so this new call becomes the bottleneck.
findings.suggestion: Build a set once: active_skus = {item.sku for item in catalog.active()}. Membership checks then become O(1) and the function runs in O(C+S).
findings.title: Membership test against a list makes unknown-SKU detection quadratic
